headline: Bitcoin heads into tonight's weekly close needing $78,232 to snap a four-week losing run, Binance's CFO steps down as hack withdrawals reopen, and MEXC sees $126M leave after a US Treasury cut-off order.

market.asOf: Read about 15:55 UTC Sun 8 Nov (22:55 Bangkok) from CoinGecko coin pages. Use the live prices on this page.
market.fearGreed: Fear: the alternative.me Crypto Fear & Greed Index reads 28 (Fear) for Sun 8 Nov, up from 25 (Extreme Fear) on 7 Nov. CoinMarketCap's own index shows 31.

stories.title: Bitcoin needs a close above $78,232 tonight to avoid a fifth losing week
stories.summary: Bitcoin's weekly candle closes at 00:00 UTC Monday (07:00 Bangkok). It opened the week at $78,232, per CryptoTicker, so a close below that makes five red weeks in a row. US spot bitcoin ETFs lost a net $1.28 billion over 2-6 November, per crypto.news.
points: The week's high was $81,131 on Wednesday and the low $74,722 on Friday, per CryptoTicker.
Weekly closes have fallen from $86,507 on 4 Oct to $78,231 on 1 Nov, per CryptoTicker.
BlackRock's IBIT accounted for $1.21B of the week's ETF outflows, per crypto.news citing Farside. All US spot bitcoin ETFs together lost $411.9M on Friday alone.
Ether ETFs lost $365.2M over the same week, per crypto.news.
Altcoins fell harder over 7 days: NEAR -15.21%, ENA -18.6%, HYPE -11.96%, per crypto.news (read 12:32 UTC).

sources.label: crypto.news: bitcoin and altcoin weekend watch

stories.title: Binance's CFO steps down as hack withdrawals keep reopening
stories.summary: Binance restored HYPE and APT withdrawals on 8 November and aims to reopen INJ, Plasma, NEAR and LTC by the end of next week, a target rather than a fixed date. Separately, CFO Kaiser Ng is leaving; co-CEO Yi He says the handover was planned about six months ago, before the hack, per The Block.
points: Justin Yek, formerly VP of finance at Airwallex, replaces Ng, per The Block.
Sources differ on the hack's size: about $6.3B per crypto.news, $6.43B per The Block.
About $2.85B has been frozen, per The Block; about $124M of stolen altcoins were swapped into bitcoin, per The Block citing Elliptic.
Binance plans to rebuild its SAFU emergency fund to about $1B, per crypto.news.

sources.label: crypto.news: Binance restores HYPE and APT withdrawals

stories.title: Money leaves MEXC after the US Treasury moves to cut it off
stories.summary: The US Treasury ordered US financial institutions to stop moving funds to or from MEXC Global, alleging at least $16 billion in illicit transactions. The cut-off starts 30 days after the order is published in the Federal Register. MEXC says it is operating normally and user assets are secure.
points: Sources differ on the total: at least $16B per the Treasury, $16.7B per CryptoSlate citing the order.
The Treasury ties about $1.5B to Russia and about $1B to more than 40 Iranian exchanges.
MEXC saw $126.03M of net outflows in 24 hours, with about $4.353B of tracked assets left, per CryptoSlate citing DefiLlama.
Only 6 of 18 USDT withdrawal networks were open on 7 Nov, per FinanceFeeds citing the Cexorer tracker; MEXC calls it routine maintenance.
MEXC CEO Vugar Usi says the order does not freeze or seize assets held on the exchange, per CryptoSlate.

briefs.title: Keplr social-login wallets drained
briefs.summary: A failure at login provider Web3Auth let attackers drain Keplr wallets created with Google or Apple sign-in; about $6.01M moved, per Bitquery data cited by crypto.news. Seed-phrase and hardware wallets were not affected.

briefs.title: Saylor hints at another Strategy buy
briefs.summary: Michael Saylor posted his Sunday bitcoin tracker chart, which usually comes before a Monday purchase notice. Strategy holds 849,327 BTC, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Travel-rule rollback published 9 Nov
briefs.summary: A Federal Register notice formally withdraws the 2020 plan to cut the crypto record-keeping threshold from $3,000 to $250.

briefs.title: Big Tech blocks tokenized shares on OKX-ICE
briefs.summary: All of the 'Magnificent Seven', including Apple and Meta, have objected to third-party tokens of their shares trading on the OKX-ICE venue, per Decrypt.

briefs.title: Crypto-in-401(k) rule reaches the White House
briefs.summary: The Labor Department sent its final rule to the White House regulatory review office on 5 Nov, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Trump Media moves 4,259 BTC to Crypto.com
briefs.summary: The coins, worth about $343.7M, back convertible notes whose holders can demand up to about $1B on 30 Nov; no sale is confirmed, per crypto.news.

briefs.title: Kalshi midterm markets top $2.5B
briefs.summary: Kalshi says its 2026 midterm markets traded more than $2.5B, up from $1.3B in 2024.
